purpose: Read-only pre-integration check for the approved #192 interim checkpoint. This is not final #192 acceptance, hosted backend functional proof, production authorization, or an immutable 11/11 gate.

backendEnvironmentMetadata.interpretation: No definition of TALLI_BACKEND_URL was visible in either the current Project or Shared variable metadata. No configured hosted backend origin was established by this inspection; no target was guessed.

hostedBackendObservation.verdict: The Preview renders its unavailable state. This does not prove successful hosted FastAPI integration.

secondaryRead.interpretation: Redirect response does not establish application readiness or backend reachability.

deploymentContract.webBehavior: The server requires an HTTP(S) origin, HTTPS except loopback, without credentials/path/query/hash. Missing configuration fails closed. The generated API client uses that origin for FastAPI calls.
deploymentContract.backendHost: No exact hosted backend origin or backend deployment target established.
deploymentContract.vercelConfig: Root vercel.json deploys apps/web/.next in dub1; it does not deploy or route a FastAPI backend.
deploymentContract.healthReadySemantics: The web /health/ready handler validates backend URL configuration only; it is not an upstream backend connectivity probe.
deploymentContract.ciCoverage: Release CI uses a loopback backend origin, builds web and Python artifacts, and exercises independent deployment order/failure isolation through the production boundary smoke. This is CI integration evidence, not hosted Preview backend proof.

acceptanceInterpretation.conclusion: The unavailable hosted backend is a preserved Preview limitation, not a separately specified additional gate for the approved interim #192 integration.
acceptanceInterpretation.basis: ADR0013's approved interim amendment and the control-plane require currently implementable billing work, truthful unavailable acquisition/renewal, preserved recovery/cancellation/refund/read/export rights, independent review, two linked immutable complete 11/11 gates, protected Release/Preview merge, and exact-main Release/Preview evidence. They do not add a separately hosted FastAPI Preview deployment or smoke. ADR0012 selects no hosting provider.
acceptanceInterpretation.limits: Vercel READY proves deployment status only. It must not be labelled customer-flow, backend connectivity, final #192, production activation, or launch proof. Full #192 remains open for source-backed runtime and all original acceptance. This artifact does not replace any remaining required gate or exact-main receipt.
acceptanceInterpretation.integrationEffect: With the live production branch set to release/production, merging this capability PR into main remains nonproduction. The independent release/production pointer and current production alias stay frozen; no promotion or production write was performed.
